trailers.quality.label: YouTube Quality Filter
trailers.quality.apiKeyMissing: No YouTube API key found, so “HD only” is unavailable.
trailers.quality.apiKeyHowToSuffix: on the Jellyfin server (for Docker under environment) and restart Jellyfin.
trailers.quality.help: Skip YouTube trailers available only in SD. Requires a YouTube Data API key in the server environment variable JELLYFIN_FEATURED_YOUTUBE_API_KEY. If quality cannot be determined, playback is allowed.
source.youtubeQualityHelp: Override the global YouTube Quality Filter for this source. Inherit uses the setting under Trailers.
app.title: Jellyfin Featured
app.intro: Adds a full-width featured-content carousel to the Jellyfin Web home page. Combine curated favourites, collections, recent releases, and random picks, then control presentation and playback here.
toolbar.label: Jellyfin Featured settings
trailers.playbackDisabledHelp: Enable background trailers to configure playback. Your saved playback settings are retained.
preset.scheduleHelp: The Schedule switch controls automatic activation. Manual loading is always available, including when scheduling is disabled. An enabled one-time schedule with no dates is always eligible.
preset.loadHelp: Load copies this snapshot into the configuration editor. Use Save configuration to apply it to the server. Enabled schedules still take precedence.
preset.snapshotLoaded: “{name}” loaded into the editor. Save configuration to apply these settings.
preset.snapshotSaved: “{name}” updated from current settings. Save configuration to keep this snapshot.
preset.title: Featured presets and scheduling
preset.help: Capture complete Featured configurations and load them manually or activate them automatically on a schedule. Snapshots include sources, filters, personalization policy, layout, and trailers.
preset.defaultHelp: The settings in the other tabs remain the fallback whenever no enabled preset is active.
preset.name: Preset name
preset.priorityHelp: When schedules overlap, the higher priority wins. Equal priorities prefer the preset that starts later.
preset.timeZoneHelp: Recurring boundaries use this IANA time zone and automatically follow daylight-saving changes. If a local time is skipped by a clock change, the next valid minute is used.
preset.enabledHelp: New presets start disabled so an open-ended schedule cannot unexpectedly replace the default experience.
preset.snapshotHelp: To change this preset's content or presentation, adjust the other tabs and capture their current values again. Name, schedule, enabled state, and priority are preserved.
preset.emptyHelp: Capture the current configuration to reuse it later. Load it manually or add an optional schedule.
preset.nowDefault: No preset applies right now, the settings of the other tabs are used.
feedPreview.title: Feed preview
feedPreview.help: Inspect the feed produced by the unsaved settings currently shown on this page.
feedPreview.whyHelp: The source rule that supplied this item.
source.title: Content sources
source.help: Add as many sources as you need. Enabled sources are combined by share, filtered, and automatically deduplicated.
source.orderHelp: Order decides which source is considered first when shares are equal.
source.name: Source name
source.weightHelp: With multiple sources, this value controls their relative share. 90 to 10 is approximately 90% to 10%. Other sources fill any unused slots.
source.minimumItemsHelp: Reserves up to this many slots for the source before remaining slots are distributed by weight. 0 disables the minimum.
source.maximumItemsHelp: With multiple available sources, limits how many items this source contributes to one feed. If it is the only available source, it continues filling the feed. 0 means unlimited.
source.fallbackHelp: Uses this source only when enabled primary sources cannot fill the requested feed.
source.allowBackgroundTrailersHelp: Applies when this source contributes a title to the feed. Requires background trailers to be enabled globally.
source.mediaPriorityHelp: The banner tries the enabled entries from top to bottom and plays the first one that works. Media excerpts and Trickplay come from the video itself and also stand in for missing artwork.
source.mediaPriority.trailersGloballyOff: Background trailers are turned off in the Trailers tab.
source.onlyUsersHelp: Restricts this complete source to the selected Jellyfin users. Leave empty to show it to every user.
filter.diversityHelp: Global limits for a broader mix across the complete feed. They relax automatically rather than returning too few items.
filter.maximumPerGenreHelp: 0 disables genre diversity. Only the first Jellyfin genre assigned to an item is counted.
filter.maximumPerFranchiseHelp: 0 disables franchise diversity. Movie franchises use Jellyfin's TMDb collection metadata.
source.help.libraries: Selects supported content directly from specific Jellyfin libraries, including videos, music albums, books, and photos.
source.help.collections: Uses content from one or more selected collections.
source.help.favourites: Uses favourites from a selected editor account while still enforcing viewer visibility.
source.help.tags: Uses local content with at least one of the selected Jellyfin tags.
source.help.playlists: Uses movie and series entries from selected playlists.
source.help.recently_added: Sorts by when content was added to Jellyfin, not by its release date.
source.help.latest_releases: Sorts by the actual release date and includes only already released content from the selected time window.
source.help.random: Selects random visible content from all supported libraries.
source.help.unplayed: Selects content the active user has not watched yet.
source.help.manual_lists: Uses the curated order of selected manual source lists and mixes them with other sources according to this share.
source.help.recommendations: Uses Jellyfin 12 movie recommendations based on recently watched and liked movies. Mix with another source for users without watch history.
source.help.continue_watching: Uses resumable movies, episodes, videos and audiobooks for the active user, ordered by recent playback.
source.help.next_up: Uses Jellyfin's next episode for each series the active user is watching.
source.short.manual_lists: Curated lists in their own order
source.noManualLists: Create a manual source list under Manual Sources first.
source.additionalFiltersHelp: These filters apply only to this source and are combined with the global filters.
source.emptyHelp: Add at least one source above so the hero can return content.
source.editorAccountHelp: Favourites stay private; viewers only receive items they are allowed to access.
source.collectionsHelp: One eligible collection is picked per load, matching the original plugin behavior.
source.noCollections: No collections were returned by Jellyfin.
source.recentWindowHelp: Movies and shows with recent episodes can enter the carousel.
filter.continuousHelp: Starts with 5 items and preloads the next 5 in the background. The last 100 items remain available for back navigation, while only 20 slides are kept in the DOM.
filter.rotationHistoryHelp: Prevents content from active sources, including manual source lists, from being shown to the same user too frequently.
filter.cooldownHelp: 0 disables the cooldown. History is updated only after a slide was actually displayed.
filter.relaxCooldown: Relax cooldown when the feed is short
filter.relaxCooldownHelp: After all fresh primary and fallback sources are exhausted, reuse the oldest recently displayed items so the carousel does not remain underfilled.
filter.clearHistoryConfirm: Clear the display history for {count} selected users?
filter.librariesHelp: With no selection, all movie and TV libraries are eligible.
filter.noLibraries: No movie or TV libraries were returned by Jellyfin.
filter.globalRulesHelp: All global filters must match. They apply to every enabled source.
filter.noGlobalRules: Without global filters, only each source's settings and Jellyfin access permissions apply.
filter.metadataMissingHelp: Items with missing metadata are excluded by include rules and retained by exclude rules.
manual.title: Manual source lists
manual.help: Curate and schedule fixed title lists. Then add them under Sources & Mix and set their share of the hero there.
manual.scheduleHelp: Without a start or end date, that side of the time window remains open. Times are entered in your local time zone.
manual.searchPlaceholder: Search for a movie, series, album, book, video, or photo…
manual.emptyList: No titles in this list yet.
manual.unusedHint: No source uses this list yet.
manual.emptyHelp: Create a manual source list, search local titles, then order them with drag and drop.
users.dismissalsHelp: Let users permanently hide recommendations. Choose whether they may dismiss one title, a whole series, or a movie franchise when Jellyfin has collection metadata.
users.personalizationHelp: Choose which parts of the Featured experience users may customize. Settings that are not overridden always inherit the server defaults.
users.defaultsHelp: These values apply to every user unless an allowed user preference overrides them.
users.title: User settings
users.help: Open the same Featured profile that the selected user sees. Changes and resets are saved directly to that user’s preferences.
users.flowSelect: Sources and filters pick the titles
users.flowOrder: More points move a title up within its source
display.livePreviewHelp: Uses a real movie from your Jellyfin library and updates immediately from the settings below.
display.headerHelp: Choose how the banner looks and behaves. Click an area in the preview to jump to its settings.
display.layoutHelp: Choose the carousel's shape and movement on the home page.
display.fadeEditorHelp: Drag the start, end, and curve points directly. The end point's height controls the strength.
display.fadePointLabel: Curve point at {position} percent with {fade} percent fade
display.textPositionHelp: Places the title and description inside the banner. Phones always show them at the bottom left.
display.heroMinimumGap: Hero mode adds 52 px of base spacing. Negative values reduce it and positive values increase it.
display.metadataHelp: Choose the banner title, description, and information row.
display.actionsHelp: Choose which actions are available and where they appear.
display.navigationAndAutoplayHelp: Control arrows, pagination, autoplay, and media controls.
display.bannerPositionHelp: Applies only to banner mode; Hero mode keeps its existing arrangement.
display.behaviorHelp: Configure interaction, feed size, and device-specific visibility.
display.showControlsOnHoverOnlyHelp: Keeps controls visible on touch devices and while keyboard focus is inside the banner.
display.interactOnWholeBannerHelp: Open details by clicking or tapping the visible banner area. Buttons and navigation remain interactive when disabled.
display.autoplayHelp: Autoplay pauses while the banner is hovered, focused, or the browser tab is hidden.
trailers.backgroundHelp: Play local Jellyfin trailers, direct video files, and YouTube embeds without exposing source-specific details to the carousel.
trailers.sourceHelp: Each source keeps its own playback order under Sources. This choice only sets the order new sources start with. Manual overrides always play first.
trailers.showControlsHelp: Displays trailer play/pause, mute, and volume controls while a trailer is playing.
trailers.hideYouTubeControls: Hide YouTube trailer until controls disappear (5 seconds)
trailers.hideYouTubeControlsHelp: Starts YouTube trailers invisibly and muted. They fade in after five seconds, or after the configured trailer delay when it is longer.
trailers.waitForFinishHelp: Pauses carousel autoplay while a trailer is playing and advances when it ends.
trailers.timingHelp: Offsets trim playback without changing the source video. An end offset counts backward from the full duration.
trailers.excerptWindowHint: A random start is picked inside this window to avoid spoilers. Shorter videos use a proportionally scaled window.
trailers.excerptTranscodeHint: Files the browser cannot play directly are remuxed or transcoded by the server while the excerpt plays, and the encoding is stopped as soon as it ends.
trailers.overridesHelp: Assign a specific trailer to a title. Manual overrides always take priority over Jellyfin metadata.
trailers.overrideHint: Enter either an HTTP(S) URL or a Jellyfin trailer item ID. A visible local item takes priority when both are set.
advanced.frontendInjectionHelp: Automatic uses File Transformation, then JavaScript Injector, then direct index.html injection. Unavailable methods cannot be selected. Restart Jellyfin after changing the method.
advanced.frontendBootstrapHelp: Show a matching placeholder while the Featured frontend is loading. Disable this if it causes visual issues with your Jellyfin theme. Restart Jellyfin after changing this option.
advanced.injectionRestartRequired: Restart Jellyfin Server for the new frontend injection method to take effect.
advanced.performanceHelp: Smaller images reduce network traffic but require Jellyfin to resize them.
advanced.preparedCacheHelp: Build a per-user cache at startup and every hour. The cache is also refreshed after configuration changes and as display history consumes its items.
advanced.creditsHelp: Jellyfin Featured is a remake of the original Editor's Choice plugin by lachlandcp.
advanced.originalProject: View the original project on GitHub
advanced.diagnosticsHelp: Check frontend injection, user context, filters, and the hero items currently returned.
advanced.headerHelp: Technical settings for frontend injection, performance and troubleshooting.
advanced.diagnosticsEmpty: Run a test to see what the hero query currently returns for your account.
preview.fallbackDescription: A featured story selected from your Jellyfin library.
carousel.label: Jellyfin Featured
carousel.dismissFailed: Could not dismiss this recommendation. Please try again.
carousel.undoFailed: Could not undo the dismissal. Please try again.
carousel.favoriteError: Could not change favorite. Try again.
carousel.playstateError: Could not change play state. Try again.
preferences.title: Personalize Featured
preferences.help: Choose what appears in your Featured carousel. Changes apply only to your user account.
preferences.disabled: Personalization is disabled by the server administrator.
preferences.noDismissals: You have not dismissed any recommendations.
preferences.scope.title: Title
preferences.displayHelp: You can hide content enabled by the administrator for your user account.
preferences.genresHelp: Click to cycle: preferred ✓, excluded ×, or neutral.
